script: Here is something worth knowing if you run a website. On September 18, 2026, Fingerprint announced the launch of Bot Directory, a continuously updated, searchable repository of AI tools, bots, and crawlers. It is powered by Fingerprint's Bot Detection Smart Signal, and the directory is public, so you can look up a bot's identity, provider, and purpose yourself. You can also test your own AI agent for Web Bot Auth compliance and submit it for inclusion. Fingerprint points out that bots account for the majority of web traffic, and that many organizations still lean on legacy bot directories built before the rise of generative AI. If automated traffic is reaching your site, this gives you a calm place to start looking.
